likelihood_summary.likelihood_curve_type: one-dimensional conditional slices with all other transformed variables held at the retained posterior sample with largest log posterior

prior_model.parameterization: transformed positive variables: log(k1/k1_nom), log(k2/k2_nom), log(zeta1), log(zeta2), log(force_amp), log(force_fc)

natural_frequency_prior.distribution: because f is proportional to sqrt(k), log(f/f_nom) ~ Normal(0, 0.09^2) before truncation

damping_prior.distribution: log(zeta/zeta_nom) ~ Normal(0, 0.35^2), with zeta truncated to [0.004, 0.090]

force_prior.force_center: log(fc/95 Hz) ~ Normal(0, 0.22^2), truncated to [35, 170] Hz

frequency_channels.data_used: all complex FRF/transfer values at 120 log-spaced frequencies for Ch1-Ch4
frequency_channels.residual: observed complex channel value minus model complex channel value at every frequency point
frequency_channels.covariance: C = K_discrepancy + diag(sigma_sensor^2), with K_ij = sigma_d(f_i) sigma_d(f_j) exp(-0.5*((ln f_i - ln f_j)/ell)^2)
frequency_channels.real_imag_treatment: real and imaginary residual vectors are evaluated independently with the same covariance
frequency_channels.peak_usage: peak/notch locations are used only for reference checks and plots, not as likelihood summary statistics

flight_response_psd.data_used: all log response-PSD values at 181 log-spaced frequencies
flight_response_psd.residual: log(observed PSD) minus log(model response PSD) at every frequency point
flight_response_psd.qoi: 3*GRMS is computed after posterior sampling from each sampled response PSD; it is not the only data used in the likelihood

likelihood_formulation.desired_next_step: Infer discrepancy fields and/or hyperparameters in a hierarchical StatFEM model, preferably with replicate data so sensor noise, flight-to-flight variability, and model discrepancy are identifiable.

simulation_replicates.note: This fresh trial generates one synthetic dataset. It does not model flight-to-flight variability or repeated experiment scatter.

statfem_noise_model.frf_generation: observed = clean + realized GP model discrepancy + realized iid sensor noise
statfem_noise_model.frf_likelihood: complex residuals use covariance K_discrepancy + diagonal sensor-noise covariance; real and imaginary parts are treated independently
statfem_noise_model.response_psd_generation: observed PSD = clean PSD * exp(log-GP discrepancy + log-iid sensor noise)
statfem_noise_model.response_psd_likelihood: log PSD residual uses GP discrepancy covariance plus diagonal log sensor-noise covariance
